requiredFindings.summary: The direct description override for crates/lifecycle/src/installation.rs attributes retained LaunchMember member-offset construction to the wrong file and omits installation.rs's actual D4 read-seam behavior.
evidence: The override at /files/510/description resolves to crates/lifecycle/src/installation.rs and says D4 accounts a retained LaunchMember member offset and constructs it from the resolved bound path.
The accepted D4 diff in installation.rs only adds read_fixture::check calls to read_seam under the test/debug and debug scenario-fixtures guards, preserving failure as TreeFault::Io with call read.

LaunchMember.member_offset, the resolved member suffix, and moving the bound path are implemented in crates/lifecycle/src/retained_tree.rs and are already described by the separate /files/518/description supersession.
The proposed override therefore duplicates retained_tree.rs behavior and silently omits the actual path-specific D4 meaning of installation.rs.
requiredFindings.requiredAction: Replace the /files/510/description addition with a path-specific description of installation.rs's narrow debug/scenario-only read fixture check and typed read-Io mapping; retain member-offset/path behavior only in the retained-tree passage, then freeze an exact successor subject.
